tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun pa'i cho ga shin tu bsdus pa

don gnyis mchog stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun gyi bdag mdun bum pa bdag 'jug tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa shin tu bsdus pa'i rim pas rdzus skyes sbyong ba slob dpon a bha yā ka ra gup+ta'i rjes su 'brangs te bshad pa don gnyis mchog stsol zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// bde chen sbyor ba'i dam tshig gi// he ru ka dpal kyai rdo rje// 'khor lo'i dbang phyug nyid sprul pa'i// thub dbang sras dang bcas la bstod// 'dir dbang thob pas dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can sam+bu ṭa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i cho ga de tsam bya bar mi nus na/ gnas dben par lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu'i dbus thod pa myos byed kyis bkang bar me long dang*/ dar dmar gyis kha bcad pa'i steng du dbu rgyan gyi nang du bum pa dri'i chus bkang ba'i steng du mchod yon gyi snod rdo rje me tog srad bu btags pa bzhag cing*/ maṇ+ḍal gyi g.yas g.yon du rdor dril dang*/ nang mchod/ mchod gtor bshams pa'i mtha' skor du ci 'byor ba'i mchod pas bskor zhing*/ log pa'i sbyor bas mtshams ma sbyar ba'i tshogs rdzas ci 'byor ba dang*/ las bum/ rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru sogs nyer bsdogs byas la/ stan bde bar 'dug ste skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang nyid skad cig gis dgyes pa rdo rje sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gsal bar gyur/ nang mchod/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī auṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las| yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du gnas pa'i nang du a las thod pa'i nang du sha lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga la hūm̐ buṃ aṃ hrīḥkhaṃ trāṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbuṃ khaṃ gis mtshan pa'i steng du/ ha hoḥhrīḥ'i yi ge ser dkar sngo ba'i mdog can gsal ba la rang gi sna bug gi rlung gis bskyod pas rlung g.yos/

me sbar thod pa dros rdzas yi ge dang bcas pa zhu zhing 'dres pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes brjod la mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi myang zhing*/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ 'thor 'thung*/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ= prok+ṣa ṇaṃ= puṣ+paṃ= dhū paṃ= ā lo kaṃ= gan+dhaṃ= nai wi d+yaṃ= oṃ badz+ra shapad āḥhūm̐/ zhes byin gyis brlabs la/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdor thal kha phye bas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ un+mā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñja tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes gsum dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas gtor ma bsngos la/ rang dgyes pa rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ byin rlabs stsol mdzad dpal ldan bla ma rje// dngos grub stsol mdzad yi dam kyai rdo rje// phrin las kun sgrub dam can chos skyong tshogs// sangs rgyas chos tshogs rnams la bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar gyis tshogs bsags la/ tshogs zhing rnams rang gnas la thim par gyur par mos pa'i ngang nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang

sogs tshad med bzhi bsgoms la/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ gur/ bla bre/ mda'i dra ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i steng 'og bar mtshams thams cad sra zhing mkhregs pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūṃ hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su e las chos 'byung dkar po sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar/ sa chu me rlung gi dkyil 'khor laṃ baṃ raṃ yaṃ gyis mtshan pa'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo dkar po sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar buṃ las rin chen sna tshogs pa'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi rol du/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i ra ba/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad dang*/ de'i phyir rdo rje dang me'i 'khor yug gis bskor ba'i pho brang gi dbus su lha snam gru bzhi pa'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ mu khyud la rdo rje'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la bdud bzhi brtsigs thabs su gnas pa'i steng du thod khrag dang zla ba'i gdan la 'dab ma brgyad dang*/ lha snam zur bzhi pad+ma'i steng du thod khrag dang zla ba'i gdan dang*/ sgo bzhi'i nang du pad+ma'i steng du thod khrag gi steng du ro'i gdan dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa zhal nag po/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab zhal bzhi nag cing steng zhal dud kha/ phyag g.yas brgyad kyis rdo rje/ ral gri/ mda'| 'khor lo/ thod khrag /rdo rje/ dbyug pa/ tri shūl/ lcags kyu/ g.yon brgyad kyis dril bu/ pad+ma/ gzhu/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa/ rin po che/ sdigs mdzub/ zhags pa 'dzin pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs rgyab ma gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pas bdud bzhi mnan cing mdun zhabs gnyis rdor skyil phyed pas thod khrag dang zla ba'i gdan la 'gyings pa/

gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan zhing phyag drug dang*/ dur khrod kyi mtshan ma brgyad dang*/ dpal gyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i pang du/ yum rdo rje bdag med ma sngo sangs g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thogs nas yab la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas kyis yab kyi sked pa nas 'khril zhing*/ g.yon yab kyi g.yas dang lhan cig tu brkyangs pa khro mo'i cha lugs can/ yab yum bde ba'i nyams dang ldan zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ shar du gau rī ma dkar mo g.yas gnyis na mda' dang gri gug /g.yon gnyis na gzhu dang ro hi ta'i nya dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau rī ma dmar mo g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na lcags kyu dang phag gis mtshan pa'i thod khrag /nub tu be tā lī ser mo g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang rus sbal gyis mtshan pa'i thod khrag /g.yon gnyis na chang dang dri chus gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas gnyis na sbrul dang rkang gis gang ba'i thod pa dang skyabs sbyin/ g.yon gnyis na me thab dang dgra sta 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du puk+ka sī ser mo g.yas gnyis na shas gang ba'i thod par gnas pa'i seng ge dang mchod sbyin/ g.yon gnyis na dpag bsam gyi shing gi yal ga dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ mer sha wa rī dkar mo g.yas gnyis na byang sems kyis gang ba'i thod par gnas pa'i dge slong dang*/ g.yon gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ srin por tsaṇ+ḍa lī sngon mo g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis stag dang bcas pa'i thod khrag dang pad dkar/ 'og ma gnyis rlung ras 'dzin pa/ rlung du ḍoṃ bh-i nī nag mo g.yas gnyis na chang gis gang ba'i thod pa rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis na bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod par ce spyang dang thong gshol thogs pa/ lha snam gyi zur bzhi'i dbang ldan du gling bu ma dmar mo gling bu 'bud pa/ mer pi wang ma ser mo pi wang thogs pa/ bden bral du mu kuṇ+ḍa dmar mo rnga chen 'dzin pa/

rlung du rdza rnga ma dud mdog rdza rnga 'dzin pa/ shar sgor rta gdong ma nag mo nag dkar ser ba'i zhal gsum dang*/ steng zhal rta gdong ljang gu g.yas gnyis lcags kyu dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis zhags pa dang sdigs mdzub/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum dang*/ steng zhal phag gdong dmar po g.yas gnyis zhags pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum dang*/ steng zhal khyi gdong ser mo g.yas gnyis lcags sgrog dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu/ byang sgor seng gdong ma ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum dang*/ steng zhal seng gdong dmar mo g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lha mo bcu drug po thams cad kyang khro mo'i cha lugs can gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing bzhad pa 'od zer gyi phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yab kyi thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ lha bcu bdun gyi thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la rang rang gi g.yas dang po'i phyag mtshan gyi lte bar rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan par gyur/ ces dang skye mched byin rlabs ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mig la maṃ maṃ dkar mo/ rna bar daṃ daṃ nag mo/ snar maṃ maṃ ser po/ lce la raṃ raṃ dmar po/ dpral bar aṃ ljang gu/ snying khar naṃ nag po/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ nag pos mtshan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā khe tsā ri bhū tsā ri pa tā la wā si ni badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ spyan drangs zhing dbang bskur ba ni / gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dgyes pa rdo rje'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo dang lha rnams spyan drangs/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas/

oṃ pheṃ ku ru sa ma ya a ti ba ti hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ gtso bo'i zhal brgyad nas hūm̐ gi nga ros phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad par gyur/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod la/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med du gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya shrī he ru ka he badz+ra āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes 'khyud pa'i nga rgyal bzung ngo*// nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams la/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas bum gsang shes rab ye shes rnams rim par bskur te dbang bzhi pa tshig tsam du ngo sprad/ dbang lha rnams gnyis su med par 'dres te/ gtso bo yab yum gau rī puk+kā sī rnams la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī sha wa rī gling bu ma rta gdong ma rnams la rnam snang*/ be tā lī tsaṇ+ḍa lī pi wang ma phag gdong ma rnams la rin 'byung*/ ghasma rī ḍoṃ bhi nī mu kuṇ+ḍa khyi gdong ma rnams la 'od dpag med/ rdza rnga ma seng gdong ma la don grub kyi cod paṇa rnams su gyur/ ces dmigs la bdud rtsi thigs gtor g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis phul zhing*/ mgron rnams kyi ljags 'od kyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bar mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ slob dpon a bha yā ka ra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a nu pa ma rak+ṣi ta'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bi khyā ta de wa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ paṇa chen shākya shri'a'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ paṇa chen bhū mi shrī'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bi ma la shrī bha dra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mang dkar ba byang chub seng ge'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

skyi ston 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos rje kun mkhyen chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'dzin pa gu ṇa shrī'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhas grub bla ma rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gangs can mkhas pa'i dbang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rab 'byams shī le shwa ra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnal 'byor ar+ṣa mā lā'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog 'bangs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chos kyi dbang phyug gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du yum lha mo bcu drug so so'i sngags mthar 'bru gsum btags la 'bul zhing*/ oṃ sarba dharma pā la bī ra yo gi nī/ k+ṣe tra pā la/ de wa/ nā ga /yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ un+mā da/ a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki/ n+ya dā ya sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thams cad kyang zag med bde bas tshims nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig /oṃ a mṛ ta swā da swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung la/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par dmigs la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shapad 'i bar gyis mchod cing*/ slar yang lha mo bcu drug gi sngags rgya dang*/ rig ma bcu drug gi sngags rgyas mchod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung la/ bstod pa ni/ rdor dril thogs te/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rjes bdag la skyob// 'dod chags rdo rjes bdag la stsol// phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal ste// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun// las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa// thams cad rdo rjer bdag mgur gyur//

ces bstod nas/ mi skyo'i bar du bskyed rim bsgom/ dag pa dran pa ni/ lte ba gtsug lag khang du gsungs// mngal gnas 'dod chags bral ba nyid// sha ma'i dra ba chos gos te// ma ni de bzhin mkhan po ste// spyi bor thal mo 'dud pa yin// 'gro ba'i bya ba bslabs nas ni// āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i sngags bzlas so// gcer bur skyes shing mgo skra dang*// kha spu breg pa dge slong yin// tshogs 'di dag gi sems can rnams// sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med// zla ba bcu ni sa bcu ste// sems can sa bcu'i dbang phyug go// phyi rol 'byung ba phra rags thams cad ni rten gzhal yas khang du rnam par dag cing*| nang gi sems can thams cad kyi phung khams skye mched thams cad ni brten pa lha'i ngo bo nyid du rnam par dag pa'o// rang gi ye gdod ma'i rnam par rig pa bcos slad dang bral ba ni dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'o// zhes yun ring du bsgom mo// de nas dga' ba bzhi la rtsal sbyang ba ni/

bdag he ru kar gsal ba'i yab kyi sku'i nang du rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang spyi bor haṃ rnams gsal ba'i lte bar gtum mo'i me sbar bas/ snying kha dang mgrin pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa bcu'i sa bon rnams rtsa mdud du gnas pa dkrol zhing haṃ la reg pa'i tshe/ spyi bo'i haṃ las dkar cha'i rgyun bab pa nor bu'i rtse'i bar du son pa'i tshe dga' ba bzhi lugs 'byung gi tshul du mngon par byas shing*/ slar byang sems mas brtan gyi spyi bo'i bar du ldog pas dga' ba bzhi lugs ldog gi tshul du shes te lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro// zhes dmigs shing*/ dga' bzhi'i 'bar 'dzag chos drug gi skabs sogs ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o// de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ yum gyi thugs ka'i aṃ la sngags kyis bskor ba las sngags phreng byung ba yum gyi zhal nas thon/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs pa sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas thon te yum gyi pad+mar zhugs pa/ slar yang yum gyi zhal nas thon yab kyi zhal du zhugs te rgyun mi 'chad du 'khor bar dmigs te/ yab kyi phreng sngags ni/ oṃ aṣ+ṭā na nā ya/ piṅga lor+dhā ke sha warda mā ne/ tsa turbiṃ sha ti nai trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā lā ne kā dha ri ṇe/ adh+mā ta krūr tsit+tā ya/ ar+dhen+du daṃ ṣ+ḍī ṇe/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rā ṇa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ nā gāṣ+ṭa kān/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sha trūṃ/ ha hā/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ haṃ hāḥphaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa yab kyi rtsa sngags so// oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yab kyi snying po'o// oṃ badz+ra kartā ri he badz+ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ truṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yab kyi nye snying ngo*// hūm̐/ zhes pa yab kyi sa bon no/ /oṃ āḥnaṃ badz+ra nai rāt+mā ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

yum gyi snying po'o| | oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum gyi nye snying ngo*// aṃ/ zhes pa yum gyi sa bon no// 'khor gyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ 'khor so so'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar rang sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas/ slar 'dus rang rang gi sa bon la thim par gyur par dmigs te/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gau rī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ de bzhin du thog mtha' kun la sbyar te/ tsau rī/ be tā lī/ ghasma rī/ puk+ka sī/ sha wa rī/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ ḍoṃ bi nī/ zhes lha mo brgyad kyi snying po'o// gaṃ/ tsaṃ/ baṃ/ ghaṃ/ paṃ/ shaṃ tsaṃ| ḍaṃ/ zhes lha mo brgyad kyi sa bon no// waṃ she/ wī ṇi/ mu kuṇ+ḍe/ mṛ taṃ ge/ zhes rol cha ma bzhi'i snying po'o// waṃ waṃ/ maṃ maṃ/ zhes rol cha ma bzhi'i sa bon no// badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ.a shwa mu khi/ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐ wā rā ha mu khi/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ shwa na mu khi/ badz+ra ā we sha ya hoḥsingha mu khi/ zhes sgo ma bzhi'i snying po'o// aṃ/ baṃ/ shaṃ/ saṃ/ zhes sgo ma bzhi'i sa bon no// de ltar sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa nas bshad pa ltar bzla pa'i tshul ma 'khrugs par byas te bzla ba la 'bad do// de nas rdzogs rim/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis snod bcud srung 'khor dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang la thim/ gzhal yas khang sgo ma bzhi la thim| sgo ma bzhi rol cha ma bzhi la/ rol cha ma bzhi lha mo brgyad la/ lha mo brgyad gtso bo'i zhal brgyad la/ yum yab la/ yab thugs ka'i rdo rje la/ rdo rje hūm̐ la thim zhing*/ hūm̐ yig de nyid 'od 'bar ba bcom ldan 'das kyi ngo bor gyur par dmigs la dar cig mnyam par bzhag / slar yang hūm̐ yig zhabs kyu khog pa mgo bo zla tshes thig le nā da'i bar du bsdus nas nā da yang shin tu phra ba mi dmigs par gyur pa'i ngang nas yun ring du mnyam par bzhag cing*/ de las ldang tshe/ rang nyid skad cig gis dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/

zhabs g.yas bskum shing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis 'gying ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur par dmigs so// de dag ni bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i rim pa ste/ yan lag drug gi tshul gyis bshad pa'o// de nas bum pa bsgrub pa ni/ dbu rgyan gyi nang gi rnam rgyal bum pa dang las bum gnyis la bum mtshan dang nang gi bcud sogs dbang gi chu bo ltar 'du byas/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i bum pa dkar po mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gnyis kyi rnam rgyal nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus dang 'dab ma re re dang*/ phyi'i phyogs mtshams su sna tshogs pad+ma re re gsal ba'i dbus su pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la bdud bzhi brtsegs thabs su gnas pa'i steng du zhes pa nas/ thong gshol 'dzin pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar dang*/ rol cha ma bzhi bskyed pa'i tshe/ lha snam gyi zur bzhi zhes mi brjod par / de'i phyi rol gyi mtshams bzhir dbang ldan du gling bu ma zhes pa nas/ rdza rnga 'dzin pa'i bar dang*/ shar sgor rta gdong ma zhes mi brjod par/ phyogs mtshams kyi sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi shar du rta gdong ma zhes pa nas/ phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i dbus na zhes pa'i bar bsgoms la/ rnam rgyal bum pa dang bum mtshan rnams yongs su gyur pa las dgyes pa rdo rje lha bcu bdun pa'i rnam par gyur/ las bum gyi dbus su pad zla'i gdan la ghaṃ las rkang mar gyis gang ba'i thod pa'i nang du sbrul ghaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las ghasma rī ljang gu zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis rkang dmar gyis gang ba'i thod par gnas pa'i sbrul dang skyabs sbyin/ g.yon gnyis me thab dang dgra sta 'dzin pa/ khro mo'i cha lugs can phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ bum mtshan yang ghasma rī'i rnam par gyur

zhes dmigs la/ de nas/ yab kyi thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las zhes pa nas/ ye shes pa dang dbyer med du gyur gyi bar dang*/ de nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i zhes pa nas/ bum pa'i dbang bskur zer ba ma gtogs gsang dbang sogs mi dgos pa 'don pa spos la/ dbang gi lha rnams zhes pa nas/ cod pan du gyur/ las bum gyi lha la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces dmigs la/ mchod pa sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ chos dbyings rang bzhin ye shes las sprul pa'i// snang stong sgyu ma'i lha mo mchod yon ma// dgyes pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes byed 'bul// bzhes nas dngos grub dam pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra pra pañca sa ma ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ rkang pa gnyis par/ zhabs bsil/ 'thor 'thung*/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ sgra snyan/ zhes 'don pa spos la sngags phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod cing*/ slar lha mo bcu drug dang*/ rig ma bcu drug gi sngags rgyas kyang mchod la/ bstod pa ni/ rdor dril thogs pas/ kun rtog thams cad rnam spangs pa'i// stong nyid snying po khyod la 'dud// kun mkhyen ye shes snying po can// ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba mi shes bcad nas su| |de nyid ye shes ston mdzad cing*// bdag nyid chos las kun 'byung ba// rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal bstod// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi// pha rol phyin pa'i yon tan dag /mgon po khyod las byung ba ste// byang chub sems dpar phyag 'tshal bstod// dkon mchog gsum dang theg pa che// khams gsum 'di dag thams cad kyi// brtan dang g.yo ba khyod las byung*// 'gro ba'i dpa' bor phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba'i 'dod pa don grub phyir// yid bzhin nor bu ltar 'byung ba'i// dpal ldan bde gshegs ye shes gnas// sangs rgyas sras 'khor phyag 'tshal bstod//

ces dang*/ las bum gyi lha la/ chos dbyings ngang las khro mor sprul// ljang nag zhal phyag rgyan rnams rdzogs// phyag bzhi sbrul sogs rab thogs pa'i// g.yon brkyang gar gyis 'gyings la bstod// ces bstod cing*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes lag g.yon gyis gzung thag nas 'jus la/ rang gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng 'phros pas gzung thag la brgyud de song ba bum pa'i lha gtso 'khor gyi thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces dmigs la/ gtso 'khor gyi sngags rnams sgrub thabs ltar ci 'grub bzla zhing*/ slar yang bum chu la dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa dang*/ dung chos kyi mchod yon la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra bi pra tod ka ṭha hūm̐/ zhes pa'ang brgya rtsa sogs bzla'o// de nas gzung thag las bum steng du spos la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghasma rī oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs bzlas la/ bum pa gnyis thun mong du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brgya rtsa bzla zhing mthar/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha rnams chags pa chen pos zhu ba bum chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ bum mtshan rnams kyang slar bum mtshan so so'i rnam par gyur/ ces dmigs nas/ rnam rgyal gyi steng du mchod yon la dmigs nas/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bdun bzlas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis kar dung chos kyi chu de mchod yon du sbrengs te phul nas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod nas/ las bum gyi lhas 'dir ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba/ rab gnas sam/ dbang ngam/ sbyin sreg gam/ che ge mo'i las/ ma rdzogs kyi bar de srid du bgegs rnams zlog par mdzod cig / ces phrin las bcol la bzhag go// de nas las bum gyi chu nas dkyil 'khor gyi mtha'i mchod pa'i 'thor 'thung gi nang du bag tsam zhig blug cing*/

dung chos kyi nang du rnam rgyal gyi chu nas ran par blugs nas rnam rgyal gyi steng du bkod la bzhag ste dbang gi dus su mna' chu'i rgyu yin no// de nas mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla bre/ zhes pa nas/ wā si ni badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ gi bar sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ rang dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum gsal ba'i yum gyi dpral bar oṃ/ snying khar hūm̐/ yum gyi gsang bar hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po ze'u 'bru āḥs mtshan pa bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yab kyi gsang bar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po'i rtse mor nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan pa bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa| yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgra shī shī shī zhes pa'i sgras/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams su bzhugs pa thams cad dgyes pa rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu ba sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas thig le'i rnam par yum gyi pad+mar phyung ba/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo bdag nyid du gyur pa mdun bskyed kyi dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par dgug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ gnyis su med par byas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa dbang lha dang gnyis su med par 'dres te/ gtso bo yab yum dang gau rī puk+ka sī zhes pa nas/ don grub kyi cod pan du gyur/ ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar brjod/ mchod pa sngar ltar byin rlabs la/ phyi'i mchod pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros te/

dkyil 'khor la mchod par gyur/ dri med yid du 'ongs pa yi// sngags kyi mchod yon mchog 'di dag /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas dgyes pa'i mchog stsol cig /oṃ shrī he badz+ra shas+t+ra dz+wa la grah+ṇaka sarba bī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra pra pañca sa ma ya hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ/ de bzhin du 'thor 'thung dang*/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ zhes mchod cing*/ de nas nyer spyod lngas mchod de/ me tog 'di rnams bzang zhing dge// dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa// bdag gi dad pas khyod la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// gong gi sngags su/ puṣ+pe sbyar ba dang*/ nags tshal las byung ro yi mchog /gang zhig dri yi bdug spos 'di// bdag gi dad pas khyod la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// dhū pe= srin po 'joms shing dag byed pa// dge zhing mun pa rnams sel ba// bdag gi dad pas khyod la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// ā lo ke= lhan cig skyes dang dris sbyar ba'i// shangs la tshim byed dag pa 'di// bdag gi dad pas khyod la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// gan+dhe= bshos gtsang bza' ba dang bcas pa// kha dog dri ror ldan pa 'di// bdag gi dad pas khyod la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// nai wi d+ye= zhes nyer spyod lnga dang*/ sil snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs// dbyangs kyi nga ror ldan pa rnams// grag stong sgra yi sgrar sprul ste// mgon po mchog la 'bul bar bgyi// shapad zhes sbyar zhing mchod| slar yang*/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u rdung*// 'dod chags chen pos rjes chags pa// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// dmar mo gling bu'i sgra 'byin zhing*// ser mo pi wang sgra dang ldan// dmar mo mu kuṇ+ḍa yi rnga// sngon mo rdza rnga thogs pa dang*// sgo skyong lha mo bzhi rnams kyis// dgyes pa rdo rje tshim par mchod//

ces lha mo bcu drug gi sngags rgyas mchod cing*/ slar yang*/ rig ma bcu drug gi sngags rgyas mchod cing*/ nang gi mchod pa ni/ sgrub thabs ltar bla ma brgyud pa yi dam chos skyong dang bcas pa'i mtshan sngags mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ sbyar zhing*/ bdud rtsi thigs gtor gyis mchod la/ slar yang*/ phyag rgya rnam lnga'i gzugs sgra dri dang ro// reg bya la sogs 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// dgyes pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// bzhes nas lhan skyes dga' ba'i dngos grub stsol| |oṃ shrī he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ rū pa/ shapad/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

zhes phyag rgya dang bcas 'bul lo// gsang mchod ni/ gzugs mdzes gzhon sha sgeg 'chang yid 'ong zhing*// bcu drug na tshod lus phra rin chen brgyan// rjes chags 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal la mkhas ma// g.yung mos snyoms 'jug bde bas mchod par bya// bcom ldan 'das lha mo bcu bdun dang bcas pa dpa' rkyang du gyur pa la g.yung mo res 'khyud cing snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen pos mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes 'khyud pa'i rgya bya zhing*/ slar yang lha so so rang rang gi rnam par gyur/ ces mos so// de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa bya zhing*/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa rnams// gang tshe tha dad mi dmigs pa// deng 'dir mchod pa chen po ste// bla med mchod pa'i mchod pas mchod// ces pa'i don la dar cig mnyam par bzhag la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung la mchod cing bstod pa ni/ rdor dril thogs la/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud// stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas thugs nyid khyod la 'dud// med pa las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud| |nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud// ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud// sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud// thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud| |ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// sogs brjod/ mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod/

bzlas pa bya ba ni/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las dgyes pa rdo rje lha bcu bdun pa'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ khams gsum pa'i sems can thams cad la skal pa dang 'tsham pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pa gzhan la phan pa rnams mdzad de bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag cing*/ slar 'dus thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig la thim par gyur/ ces dmigs la/ yab yum dang 'khor rnams kyi bzlas pa ci 'grub bya'o// de nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa la gnyis las/ dang po 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ mchod gtor la nang mchod bran nas bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlabs shing*/ oṃ badz+ra i maṃ ba ling gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes pad kor dang bcas lan gsum brjod la/ thod pa kha phye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra i maṃ ba ling+ta gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ma ma shān+tiṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes gsum gyi mthar se gol bya zhing*| de bzhin du/ yum dang 'khor rnams kyi snying po la'ang i maṃ sogs sbyar ba lan gsum gsum gyis gtor ma phul te/ chu gsum nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod la/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni de nyid thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun bsgrubs pa// snying rje'i thugs kyi sems can byang chub tu| |kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub bsgrub pa'i yid// dgyes pa rdo rje dpal gyi he ru ka la bstod// ces bstod do// skabs 'dir rang gi yi dam dang*/ chos skyong gzhan yod na'ang gtor 'bul gyi rim pa rnams gtor ma so sor bshams la bya/ mgon po zhal bzhi pa la sogs par 'dir gtor 'bul rgyas par byed pa gal che'o// gnyis pa 'jig rten pa la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ sgrub grogs la dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug te phyi rol du bya ba'am/

yang na nang du'ang bya bar rung bas gtor chung dang mchod pa bshams la/ gtor chung la bdud rtsi'i bran te nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang po la sogs phyogs skyong 'khor bcas skad cig gis spyan drangs/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes gsum brjod cing pad kor dang se gol byas la/ gtor mgron 'khor bcas skad cig gis byon pa rang gi mdun du sna tshogs pad+ma sum brtsegs su yod pa'i steng du 'khod pa las/ oṃ las sku rdo rje dkar po rnam snang gi cod pan can/ bar du 'khod pa rnams hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje nag po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ 'og tu gnas pa rnams āḥlas gsung rdo rje dmar po 'od dpag med pa'i cod pan can/ thams cad kyang rdor dril 'dzin cing rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod la/ rdor thal kha phye bas| oṃ in+da dza ma dza la dzak+kha/ bhu da ba h+ni bā u rak+kha/ tsan+da sudz+dza mā da ba p+pa ta la pā tā le aṭaṭha sap+pa swā hā/ i daṃ ba ling bhuñja dzi gha phul+la dhū pa maṃ sa piṃ gha/ am+bha sap+pa kadz+dza sarba sā da khaṇati khu ṇi phe ḍa gā da/ oṃ a kā ro sogs brjod/ zhes gtor ma phul bas mgron rnams kyi ljags rdo rje hūm̐ yig dkar po can gyis gsol bas tshim par gyur par dmigs la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las bcol te/ rol mo dang bcas pas gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ g.yas rdo rje thogs pa'i pad kor dang*/ g.yon dril bu gsil bas rdo rje'i glu ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ badz+ra rā dzap+su ra ya sa ma thu/ lo tsa na da sha ye/

ak+ṣa ra bha nu swā hā/ sum+bi la sna pa ye/ bha wā ba bha sbe murta ye/ ma dza bi dza ni ye/ bhañja bi ak+ṣa rū pa bu+u/ a she sha tsi na tā ye/ dan+ta liṅga na dzo bu/ sa l+ling ging tsa ya/ sa ba su na da ma ya/ daṃ bhā ya ā da ya suṃ pa bi yaṃ/ mi kha pi pa bi ya ye/ su ha saṃ ra ra bi mo hi ya/ mo kha bi ka dza ya ye/ sa ba su na sa ha be/ dzo gi nī martā ya/ bi ni tsa ya ye/ badz+ra bi dza ye ni/ bu tat+tu u la khi ye/ sarba ma he ba hu ba hi/ ru sup+ta bi ga tsi ya ye/ badz+ra su ri ya ka dza ru/ dam+ba mo hi ya ye/ na ma ha su sa ru da mu/ dzo gi nī mu khi ya ye/ zhes brjod cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis 'thor 'thung phul ba'i yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskangs te/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ 'jig rten pa'i mgron rnams kyi rigs kyi bdag po rnams bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ mgron rnams rang rang gi gnas su gshegs par gyur par mos nas/ de nas hūm̐ mdzad kyi nga rgyal gyis/ oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs kyis bgegs bskrad la/ oṃ pra we sha bha ga wān ma hā su kha mok+ṣa pu raṃ sarba sid+dhi su kha nirbabra ti pa ra ma su khot+ta ma sidh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pra sidh+ya swā hā/ zhes rang nyid spro ba bskyed nas/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hūm̐ gis dkyil 'khor gyi rtsig pa bteg nas nang du zhugs pas lha la bskor ba byas te/ lag tu me tog thogs la shar nas/ oṃ pa ra ma su khā sha ya su la li ta bi lā sa na mi te t+na mā mi bha ga wān+taṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hi hi hi hi hīḥ pra tīts+tsha ku su māñja li nā tha hoḥ zhes me tog gtso bo la phul nas/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi nga rgyal gyi ngang nas/ oṃ badz+roṅghā ṭa sa ma ya pra we sha ya hūm̐ gis shar sgo sogs bzhi ka rim gyis phye nas/ oṃ sa ma ya pra we sha yā mi| zhes me tog de nyid slar rang gi mgor bcing bar bsam/ spyi bor thal mo sbyar te/ oṃ pra ṇā men sarba ta thā ga taṃ/ zhes phyag byas la/

sems can thams cad la dngos grub thams cad kyi bka' drin stsol cig | ces gsol ba btab nas/ slob ma rjes 'dzin yin na skabs 'dir/ bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i gtso bos rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba mdzad par dmigs te/ skabs 'dir 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dbang rdzogs par blangs shing dam tshig slob ma zhes pa'i mal du bdag nyid ces dang*/ bla ma zhes pa'i mal du gtso bo zhes 'don pa spos la bdag 'jug blang ngo*// de nas dkyil 'khor pa la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ oṃ/ dam tshig mchog gi 'dod pa mchog /bden pa gang gi ye shes che// de yi dkyil 'khor mgon khyod rnams// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma dag /kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog / ces gsol ba btab bo// de nas slob ma rnams las bum gyi chus khrus byas maṇ+ḍal phul te/ yol ba'i phyi nas thal mo sbyar nas/ yon tan rgya mtsho khyod mthu yis// de nyid bla med shes par 'tshal// rdo rje'i dbang bskur kun mkhyen gyis// bka' drin che de bdag la stsol// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ tsak+ṣurbahan+dha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐ gis bkab/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gtad la/ las bum gyi chus bsangs la/ slob ma skad cig gis dgyes pa rdo rje zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i spyi bor zla ba la oṃ/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥ snying khar nyi ma la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od kyis lus 'od gsal bar gyur/ ces mos la/ thun mong gi sdom gzung ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar gsum dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom bzung ni/ sras bcas sangs rgyas dpa' bo dang*// rnal 'byor ma kun bdag la dgongs// bdag ni da nas byang chub bar// byang chub sems mchog bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims rnam gsum rtag tu bsrung*| |rdo rje rtag pa'i dam tshig tu// dkon mchog gsum gzung mi spang ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs kyi dam tshig tu// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi| |rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig tu// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gzung*// las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ */

sdom pa thams cad rab tu gzung*/ */mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral bsgral dang ma grol dgrol| |dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces gsum bya/ kye/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// zhes dris par/ slob mas/ skal bzang bde chen gnas la dga'// zhes lan btab/ yang*/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya// zhes 'dri/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go// zhes gsol/ slob ma'i snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i dbus su/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur par mos te / oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta at+pā da yā mi/ zhes brjod/ rdo rje snying khar bzhag la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes sems bskyed nas/ gsang bar gdam pa ni/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje lag pa dang bcas pa slob ma'i mgor bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyi/ khyod kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing*/ ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// zhes brjod la/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ye hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes slob ma yol ba'i nang la khrid par mos la yol ba bsal te/ slob mas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni phyag 'tshal bstod// gtso 'khor lha mor bcas pa yi// lha rnams la ni phyag 'tshal bstod// ces lan gsum gyi phyag byas la/ dam tshig bsgrag pa'i dang po phan yon gyi dam bzhag ni/ mgor rdo rje bzung nas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ des na ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/

khyod kyis kyang dkyil 'khor 'di ma mthong ba'i mdun du smra bar mi bya/ smras na khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod/ rdo rje mgor bzhag dril bu gsil zhing nyes dmigs kyis dam la bzhag pa ni/ khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje 'di// gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la// 'di smras na ni spyi bo 'gems| | zhes snying khar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ/ de ring dgyes pa rdo rje rang*// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu spyi bo 'gems// zhes brjod/ gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ rnam rgyal gyi steng gi dung chos kyi chu slob ma'i khar byin zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ste// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig /oṃ pañca a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ zhes 'thung du bcug /slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ slob dpon gyi lag pa rdo rje dang bcas pas/ slob ma'i lag pa rnams bzung ste/ deng nas bzung ste khyod kyi dgyes pa rdo rje nga yin gyi ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyi nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /gal te byas na khyod ya nga ba ma spang bar tshe'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ro// zhes dam bsgrag go// ye shes dbab pa'i don du slob mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i ye shes bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes gsum brjod/ slob ma rnams skad cig gis dpal dgyes pa rdo rje yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i snying khar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rjes mtshan pa hūm̐ sngon po/ mgo bor waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa zla ba la haṃ dkar po/ mgrin par yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa zla ba la āḥdamar pos mtshan pa'i snying khar hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/

thugs sku gsung gi rdo rje rnams spyan drangs pa so so'i sa bon la thim/ rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pas sbar ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raṃ gyis mtshan zhing 'od 'phro ba la gnas pa'i dzhaiḥdamar pos lus 'degs shing dzhaiḥ'i 'od kyi tshogs rkang pa'i bu ga nas zhugs pa dang sa bon gsum gyi 'od zer gyis lus thams cad gang bar gyur/ ces dmigs la/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril thogs la/ sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya slob ma'i snying khar bzhag la/ 'di khyod dam tshig rdo rje ste// rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya gang*// rdo rje ye shes bla na med// de ring khyod la 'bad par mdzad// ces brjod la/ sbyar ba'i spos bdug cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/

he badz+ra kro dha dz+nyā na ā we sha ya/ s+t+waṃ bha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya hūm̐ a dzhaiḥ zhes lan brgya'i bar du brjod la dbab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis rdo rje rgya gram bzhag la brtan par bya'o// dkyil 'khor gyi bar snang gi kha dog la bltar bcug la/ bla mas/ khyod kyi mig lam ji ltar snang*// zhes dris par/ kha dog gang mthong smra ba'am/ dkar ser dmar ljang mthing khar mthong*// zhes lan gdab/ bla mas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams 'grub// ces lung bstan/ bla mas/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis slob ma bcug pa 'dis| |bsod nams ji lta de ltar shog /'di yi dngos grub ji 'drar 'gyur// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// bsod nams mthu yang ji 'dra ba// de 'dra'i dkyil 'khor du gyur cig | ces bden pa brjod/ slob mas me tog thogs la/ oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa sha shwa ta me bha wa hṛ da yaṃ me a dhiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ a khaṃ bī ra pra tīts+tsha ku su māñja li nā tha hoḥ zhes ltos pa med par dor la gang la phog pa'i lung bstan/ bla mas/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes me tog de nyid slob ma'i mgor bcings/ dgyes pa rdo rje deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su// dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos| |khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ */dngos grub kun gyi phun sum tshogs// dam tshig mchog tu 'khyud sbyor gyi// rdo rje pad+ma rtse rol ba// gsang sngags thams cad sgrub par gyis// he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ zhes dkyil 'khor bstan to// de nas rdo rje slob mas dbang gi don tu maṇ+ḍal phul nas/

slob mas/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can// de ltar yon tan 'byung ba sogs// de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig / ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma shar sgor pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du bzhag pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis slob ma bkug pa'i zhal du bcug /sku'i dbyibs rgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar bab pa skad cig gis hūm̐ dang rdo rje las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po yum dang bcas par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par thim zhing*| slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yum dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rgyal ba yab yum rnams snyoms par zhugs pa zhu nas spyi bo nas zhugs rdo rje'i lam nas byang sems su gyur pas dbang bskur ba pad+ma nas thon pas mi bskyod pa dgyes pa rdo rje sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum dang bcas par gyur pa dbang stegs la 'khod par gyur par dmigs/ rnam bum bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bum chu hūm̐ dang rdo rje las mi bskyod pa dgyes pa rdo rje sngon po rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pa snyoms par zhugs pa zhu nas bum pa'i chur gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor pas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i spyan ma la sogs pas slob ma'i steng du/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing rol mo'i sgra dang glu gar mdzad/

me tog gi char 'bebs/ phyag gis cung zad yo bar bzung ba'i bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyis gang bas dbang bskur/ gzugs rdo rje ma sogs kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad par gyur/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ de wa pi tsu sogs/ oṃ badz+rod ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes bum chus dbang bskur zhing blud/ de nas/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la thim/ chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ puṣ+paṃ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de dag gis mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang gi dri ma dag /rnam shes kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ rigs 'di nyid kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// zhes don bshad/ de nas byang chub rdo rjes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma dang*/ dbu rgyan bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma dang dbu rgyan aṃ dang rin po che las rin 'byung dgyes pa rdo rje ser po rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pa snyoms par zhugs pa zhu nas dbu rgyan du gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor pas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i spyan ma la sogs pas slob ma'i steng du/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing rol mo'i sgra dang glu gar mdzad| me tog gi char 'bebs/ phyag gis cung zad yo bar bzung ba'i bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyis gang bas dbang bskur/ gzugs rdo rje ma sogs kyis bkra shis brjod/

khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad par gyur/ dbu rgyan slob ma'i mgor bskon/ thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi// rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥmu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ badz+rod ka sa chu dbang bskur/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la thim/ chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de dag gis rin 'byung cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma dag /tshor ba'i phung po gnas 'gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rigs 'di nyid kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// de nas/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab/ slob ma dang*/ rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma dang rdo rje hrīḥdang pad+ma 'od dpag med dmar po dgyes pa rdo rje rang 'dra ba'i yum la 'khyud pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pa snyoms par zhugs pa zhu nas rdo rjer gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor pas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i spyan ma la sogs pas slob ma'i steng du/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing rol mo'i sgra dang glu gar mdzad/ me tog gi char 'bebs/ phyag gis cung zad yo bar bzung ba'i bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyis gang bas dbang bskur| gzugs rdo rje ma sogs kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad par gyur/ rdo rje thogs te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi// dbang ni de ring khyod dbang bskur// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// rab tu 'grub phyir rdo rje zung*// oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa twi twaṃ/

a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes slob ma'i snying mgrin dpral bar reg cing*/ lag g.yas su sbyin/ badz+rod ka sa chu dbang bskur| dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la thim/ chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de dag gis 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag /'du shes kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ sor rtog ye shes mngon du byas/ rigs 'di nyid kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// de nas/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab| slob ma dang*/ dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma dang dril bu khaṃ dang ral gri las don yod grub pa dgyes pa rdo rje ljang gu rang 'dra ba'i yum la 'khyud pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pa snyoms par zhugs pa zhu nas dril bur gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor pas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i spyan ma la sogs pas slob ma'i steng du/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing rol mo'i sgra dang glu gar mdzad/ me tog gi char 'bebs/ phyag gis cung zad yo bar bzung ba'i bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyis gang bas dbang bskur/ gzugs rdo rje ma sogs kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad par gyur/ dril bu thogs te/ oṃ/ dril bu shes rab dang ldan pa/ */shin tu dpa' bo nyid dbang bskur// dam tshig rdo rjer gnas pa khyod// bdag po'i dbang bskur rgyal mnos shig /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes g.yon du sbyin zhing*/ slob mas rdor dril thogs te 'khyud pa'i rgya bya zhing*/ bcom ldan bzung ngo bdag la ni// yang dag nye bar gyur par mdzod//

ces brjod la dkrol/ badz+rod kas chu dbang bskur| dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la thim/ chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ nyer spyod lngas mchod / de dag gis don grub dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog gi dri ma dag /'du byed kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ bya grub ye shes mngon du byas/ rigs 'di nyid kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// de nas/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab/ slob ma dang*/ rdor dril bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma dang aṃ dang 'khor lo las rnam snang dgyes pa rdo rje dkar po rang 'dra ba'i yum la 'khyud pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pa snyoms par zhugs pa zhu nas rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor pas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i spyan ma la sogs pas slob ma'i steng du/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing rol mo'i sgra dang glu gar mdzad/ me tog gi char 'bebs/ phyag gis cung zad yo bar bzung ba'i bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba dang rdor dril mnyam par spyi bor bsnams pas dbang bskur/ gzugs rdo rje ma sogs kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad par gyur/ rdor dril mnyam par spyi bor dbang bskur/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// rtag pa'i rdo rje rab zhugs te// mi shigs rdo rje ming ldan pas// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye zhes bos nas/ chai ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// zhes ming gdags pa kho bos bgyis pa'i dbang bskur gyi chu bo ltar gdags so//

oṃ badz+rod kas chu dbang bskur/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la thim/ chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de dag gis rnam snang ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug gi dri ma dag /gzugs kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rigs 'di nyid kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*| |dbang 'di rnams kyis spang bya ma rig pa lnga dag nas rig pa ye shes lnga thob par byed pas rig pa'i dbang zhes dang*/ bum chu'i 'jug pas chu dbang zhes bya zhing*/ bya rgyud kyi rgyud mtha' dag nyan bshad bsgrub pa la dbang ba yin no// zhes go ba sbyin/ slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gang gis bdag ni khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa'i// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*// thugs rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol// ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis slob ma bkug pa zhal du bcug /sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar bab pa skad cig gis hūm̐ dang rdo rje las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdor dril 'dzin pas yum rdo rje snyems ma la 'khyud par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par thim zhing*/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yum dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rgyal ba yab yum rnams snyoms par zhugs pa zhu nas spyi bo nas zhugs rdo rje'i lam nas byang sems su gyur pas dbang bskur ba pad+ma nas thon te dbang stegs la 'khod par gyur/ ces pa'i bar rig dbang skabs ltar byas la/ slob dpon gyis/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag

/bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// zhes rdo rje slob ma'i g.yas su gtad la/ des kyang*/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes gsor zhing bzung*/ dril bu thogs te/ aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// ces g.yon du gtad/ des kyang*/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' yis// dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur// oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe aḥ zhes g.yon pas dkrol zhing 'khyud pa'i rgya byas la/ slob dpon gyis/ yid kyi lus ni brten par bya// zhes dam tshig gsum sbyin zhing*/ rdo rje rab gnas rdo rje ni// che dang dril bu chen po zung*// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// zhes brjod la/ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas spyan drangs| mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor pas zhes pa nas/ bgegs bskrad par gyur

gyi bar bum dbang gi skabs ltar brjod la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi tshig bcad dang */ sarba ta thā ga ta 'i sngags kyis chu dbang bskur/ de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la bstim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog dor la brtan par bya/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dkyil 'khor dag pa bshad pa ni/ rigs kyi bu thar pa chen po'i pho brang rnam snang gi rang bzhin rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi rol du pad ra dur khrod rdo ra me ri dang bcas pa ni/ rang gi sems kyi snang ba'i dkyil 'khor yin la/ sems nyid rtogs pa'i gsal snang ma 'gag pa las sgo dang rgyan sna tshogs pa du mar snang ba yang byang phyogs so bdun la shar ba ni dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid/ sems nyid phung khams skye mched du shar ba ni rang bzhin dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i yab yum 'khor bcas su snang ba ste/ don du na rang gi sems nyid las gzhan pa'i dgyes pa rdo rje yod par ma sems shig /de ltar na'ang de'i gsal snang gi phyogs ma 'gag pa las ni phrin las kyi rol pa 'gag med du 'char ba'i phyir/ rang gi sems gdod ma nas ma skyes pa chos kyi sku nyid las slar yang de'i snang cha du mar gsal zhing ma 'gag pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dgyes pa rdo rje ste/ de'i mdangs sna tshogs pa'i rol par 'char zhing sgo du mar gsal bas sprul pa'i sku gang la gang 'dul du ston zhing de dag gi ngo bo ni/ snang stong zung 'jug chu zla lta bur nges pas na ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang*/ de thams cad kyang lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes snyoms 'jug gi rol pa las ma 'das pas na bde ba chen po'i sku ste/ de ltar na sku lnga yongs su rdzogs pas dgyes pa rdo rje ste/

rang mdangs 'gag med du yum dang*/ rang rtsal las sprul pa'i lha mo rnams su ngo shes par gyis la de dag gi dam tshig bsrung ba dang*/ bza' ba dang*/ bsten pa dang*/ blang ba dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ phyir zlog pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang*/ der slob mar dbang bskur ba dang*/ rab gnas/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg /dbye ba dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ rmongs pa dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ rmugs pa sogs rgyud kyi rtsa ba dang yan lag gi phrin las rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya bar 'os pa rnams khyod kyi las su rig par gyis shig / ces don bshad/ bzlas lung sbyin pa/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan bdag gis sbyin lags kyi// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes dkyil 'khor pa la gsol ba btab nas/ slob mas/ sngags 'di'i dbang bskur ye shes che// dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol// bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs nas snying khar sa bon gyi mthar g.yas su bskor ba dpon slob gnyis kas mos te/ yab yum gtso bo dang bcas pa'i sngags tshar gsum slob ma la bzlar gzhug /slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes me tog gtor/ skabs 'dir mig sman bku ba/ me long bstan pa/ mnga' 'phang ba rnams bya bar bshad cing*/ cho ga spros pa che bar 'jigs pas ma spros shing*/ bya bar 'dod na dbang gi chu bor bshad pa ltar bya'o/ */ de dag gis mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas so| | de nas gsang dbang zhu ba'i don du slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul te/ yangs pa'i spyan can drangs shing bcug ste ral pa'i tshul bzhin mdzad// rnam dag ye shes chu des 'gro ba rnams kyi sdig pa'i dri ma bkrus| |byams pa'i gzung ma bdag nyid che dang lhan cig brtse mdzod la// thugs rje'i rang bzhin dag pa'i chu yis bdag nyid dbang bskur cig

/ ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ mig dar bkab/ slob dpon dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum du gsal ba snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad spyan drangs pa bde ba'i ngo bor zhu ba'i byang sems lhan skyes kyi dga' ba brtan par byas pa'i thig le sbyor mtshams su bab pa yab yum gnyis ka'i dkar dmar mtheb srin gyis btsir ba slob ma'i khar sbyin par mos la/ dkyil 'khor dbus kyi thod pa'i bdud rtsi sbyin zhing*/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis// ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur// byang chub sems ni bzang po yis// de ltar bu khyod dbang bskur ro// oṃ de wa pi tsu sogs yab yum gyi snying po bzla zhing sbyin/ slob mas kyang*/ a hoḥm hā su kha// zhes btung*/ byang sems de nyid btung bas bde ba dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par bsam/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bsal/ de dag gis kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma sbyangs/ lam rang byin rlabs kyi rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas so// de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul te/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung ba// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du| |bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ mig dar bcings la/ gtso bo'i yum las spros pa'i bdag med ma zhe+ig bdag la gtad par mos la/ lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis//

zhes bla mas slob ma la gtad pa'i tshe/ lha mos/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di// bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan// gang zhig cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun du bdag gnas so// sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa// pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// blun po gang zhig 'di spangs pa// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// bhañja mok+ṣa hoḥ zhes brjod par mos/ slob ma skad cig gis dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang zhes pa nas/ dpal gyis chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar bskyed la/ de'i pang du yum bdag med ma zhes pa nas/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar yang bdag bskyed ltar las/ de nas/ yum gyi dpral bar oṃ snying khar hūm̐ zhes pa nas/ bde ba chen po'i sgra shī shī shī zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed spyan 'dren ltar brjod la/ shī'i mjug tu/ ha ha ha swā hā/ zhes brjod/ slob mas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis rgyal ba yab yum spyan drangs pas lus byin gyis brlabs nas/ slob ma yab yum bsrubs pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor bas snyoms 'jug gis spyi bo'i haṃ zhu ba thig le'i rnam par spyi bo nas nor bu'i rtse mor son pa'i tshe dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong*/ bde stong lhan skyes ye shes nges par byas/ slar hūm̐ zhes gyen du drangs pas spyi bor sleb pa'i bar du dga' ba bzhi lugs ldog gi tshul du nyams su myong bar mos la/ dar cig mnyam par bzhag /nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dbye/ de dag gis bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du phyag rgya'i shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob| yid kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas so//

dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul te/ bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis| |gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// yang dag ye shes chen po'i don// tshig gi rin chen dbang bskur stsol// ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ mig dar bcings la/ slob dpon gyis/ rigs kyi bu khyod la dbang gsum pa'i don ngo sprod pa'i don gyi mtshon byed dpe'i lhan skyes de nyid don dam byang sems kyi myu gu yin la/ de'i rgyun bskyangs pas gong 'phel du gyur nas sgrib med kyi kho na nyid yan lag bdun ldan gyi phyag rgya chen po rdo rje 'chang du shar ba ni dbang bzhi pa ste/ de yang brtag pa gnyis pa'i phyi ma le'u bcu gnyis pa las/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/*/rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes pa'i don khyod kyis go zhing rig pas rtogs par bya ba dag go// zhes ngo sprad/ nyer spyod lngas mchod| oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bsal/ de dag gis don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ lam bden gnyis zung 'jug gi rdzogs rim phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub par byas so// zhes brda sbyar/ de nas mtha' rten rnams las/ rig ma'i brtul zhugs ni/ rig ma'i lag pa slob ma'i lag tu gtad par mos la/ thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min// 'gro gsum 'di yang dag pa ste// de phyir 'di dang bral ba ni// khyod kyis nam yang bya ba min// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med// rmongs pa gang zhig 'di spangs pa// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs// zhes gtad/ de nas rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ slob ma skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpar

mos la / rdo rje gtad/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje sems dpa' phyag na gnas// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs bstan// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// zhes slob ma'i g.yas su gtad/ des kyang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi hi hi hi hi hiḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la bzung*/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ ḍā ma ru/ thod pa rnams la lha'i snying po lan gsum sogs kyis btab pa slob ma la gtad la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya 'di// phyi nang gsang bar yang dag gnas| |kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u thod pa'i snod// byin pa dpa' bos bzung bar gyis// zhes brjod la byin/ de nas rus pa'i rgyan drug sogs ster bar mos na dbang gi chu bo ltar sbyin zhing*/ mi mos kyang chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ro| |de nas lung bstan pa ni/ slob dpon sprul pa'i sku'i cha lugs kyis/ oṃ/ srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bton nas// srid pa shin tu zhi ba'i phyir// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// bdag gis khyod ni lung bstan bgyi// kye dpal zhes gsang mtshan bos te/ che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhurbahu waḥswaḥ zhes lung bstan/ rjes gnang ni/ ral gri slob ma'i lag g.yas su gtad la/ de ring nas bzung 'jig rten la// sna tshogs phrin las 'khor lo bskor// skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// phrin las sna tshogs kun sgrubs shig / ces sbyin no// 'di ni sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud phyi ma nas gsal bar gsungs pas/ dkyil chog 'di nyid la ral gri'i rjes gnang 'di ni med du mi rung ba yin la/ 'khor lo sogs kyi rjes gnang yang sbyin par spro na/ dbang gi chu bo ltar bya zhing ma byas kyang skyon med do// de nas dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod pa ni| slob dpon gyis/ hoḥ khyod rnams da ni rnam par grol// slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams dag kyang dgongs par gyur| |sdig pa kun las rnam par grol// de ring khyod rnams bde bar gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di yis ni// phyin chad 'ching ba khyod la med// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das| |khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid che// bdag po nyid du khyod nges so// sngar bshad pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams kyang legs par srungs shig

/ ces brjod/ slob mas/ de ltar bgyi'o| | zhes dang*/ de ring gson pa 'bras bur bcas// de ring skyes pa'ang 'bras bur bcas// da ni sangs rgyas rigs su gyur// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te// 'gro kun don la brtson par bya'o// zhes brjod/ de nas/ de dag gis dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang rnams mdor bsdus te ma tshang ba med pa legs par thob pas/ sngar bshad pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams bsrung snyam pas/ slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa// de bzhin du ni bdag gis bgyi// deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyod kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol| | zhes brjod la/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas tshogs kyi longs spyod rnams la bdud rtsi gtor zhing nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ tshogs phud cung zad cig dkyil 'khor gyi mthar phul ba la/ hūm̐é rdo rje 'chang dbang rnal 'byor ma// 'jigs med 'byung gnas la sogs pa// rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa'i tshogs// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs// bcom ldan dgyes pa rdo rje mchog /bdag med lha mo yum dang bcas// sprul pa'i ḍā kir bcas pa rnams// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs// chos skyong dam can srung ma'i tshogs// ye shes 'jig rten sprul 'khor bcas// ma dang mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro rnams// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs// tshogs khang pho brang dam pa 'dir// dgyes par bzhugs la tshogs gtor gyi// mchod pa bla med 'di bzhes la| |mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*// mchog thun dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes 'bul zhing*/ tshogs kyi ma da na'i snod nas g.yon pa'i theb srin gyis thigs gtor 'bul zhing bla ma brgyud pa dang dkyil 'khor pa'i mtshan sngags mthar yi ge gsum btags pa nang mchod 'bul ba'i skabs ltar bya'o// skabs 'dir rang

gi yi dam dang chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul zhing bskang ba sogs bya bar spro na de rnams kyi gtor ma bshams la 'bul lo// ma hā kā lā tsa turmu kha la gtor ma nges par 'bul dgos/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes phyag 'tshal/ g.yas kyis ma da na'i snod thogs/ g.yon gyis ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya slob dpon la bstan la/ hoḥ ltos shig dam pa'i chos mdzes pa// 'di la rnam rtog yod ma yin// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum// rang bzhin gcig pas lhan cig bza'//

zhes 'bul/ bla mas pad kor dang bcas pas/ bde gshegs chos ni sdig med cing*// 'dod chags la sogs skyon dang bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// de nyid la ni bdag cag 'tshal// zhes blangs shing*/ de nas tshogs rdzas rnams dpon slob la drangs shing*/ de dag kyang lus ngag yid gsum 'chal ba ma yin par sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa'i kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ltar lhag ma bsdus la/ slob dpon lag gnyis mtheb mdzub so sor rtse sprad nas gzhan rnams brkyangs pa kha'i thad du bcas pa'i kha'i nang nas chang gi kha phru btab la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs gsum gyis byin brlabs/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ hūm̐é lhag ma'i longs spyod la dbang ba'i// dur khrod nyul ba'i phra men dang*// lha klu phyogs skyong zhing skyong rnams| |ḍā ki zhing dang sngags las skyes// sha za sde brgyad la sogs pa// ma lus tshur byon lhag ma yi// longs spyod dam pa 'di snoms la// dpal chen bka' las ma 'da' bar| |dam tshig can gyi las sgrubs shig /nyams pa rnams la bka' chad kyi// dmod pa'i sbyor bas rdeg par mdzod// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi// phyi nang bar chad zhi ba dang*| |phrin las mtha' dag 'grub par mdzod// oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ bhak+ṣa bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes gtsang sar bskyal lo// de nas mjug chog ni/ dkyil 'khor dang bum pa'i lha la chu gsum nyer spyod rol mos mchod cing*/ bstod pa gang yang rung bas bstod la/ thal mo snying khar sbyar zhing*/ rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can// smyo med dgyes pa rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying brtser ldan// lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog / ces smon lam btab/ gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa// khyod rnams lus can skyabs yin phyir// mgon pos de kun bzod par gsol//

zhes dang*/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod| |ji ltar rjes mthun dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ mdun bskyed bum bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ ces mos la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs/ shis brjod ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang rnal 'byor ma// 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhabs la sogs// drin can bla ma brgyud par bcas rnams kyis// byin rlabs dge ba'i bkra shis dpal yon stsol// bde stong zung 'jug bcom ldan kyai rdo rje// bdag med yab yum mnyam sbyor 'khor lo'i mgon// sprul pa'i lha mo rnams dang dgyes dgur rol// bde chen nges don bkra shis dge legs stsol// sprul pa'i gzhal med khang chen gzi brjid 'bar// bkod legs rgyan gyi rnam pas 'dod dgu stsol// 'khor yug bsrung ba'i 'khor los mi thub srung*// rten 'brel mtha' rgyas bkra shis bde legs stsol// dam pa'i drang nges chos kyis legs skyong zhing*// rnal 'byor dam ldan rnams kyis stongs grogs mdzod// nyams pa'i steng du bka' yi chad pa 'bebs// bstan srung chen po rnams kyi bkra shis stsol// ces dang*/ gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs pas byin chags par bya zhing yo byad rnams bsdus la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// 'di dag ni sam+bu ṭa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa dang*/ dbang gi chu bo chen po dang*/ mchod chog dkyil 'khor bzhi'i dga' ston rnams mang bas rgyun 'khyer dang blo chung rnams kyi 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir shin tu bsdus shing don tshang bar bsdebs pa 'di'ang*/ spros pa la dga' na gong du bshad ba'i mngon dkyil der rtogs par bya'o// 'dir smras pa/

sam+bu ṭa yi dgongs pa dag /gtso bor byas pa'i kyai rdo rje// mtshon can bcu bdun pa yi ni// dkyil chog sngon chad bod du med// de bas rgyun 'khyer nyams len du// 'jug bde don dril tshig nyung ba// 'di ni sngon med nor bu yi// kha sbyor rgyud kyi kyai rdo rje// phreng ba'i nang tshan las gzhan yang*// gud du med mod de dag kyang*// khol bur kha tshang don 'dus pa// 'di 'dra chos kyi grags pa yi// blo gros kyis ni bskrun no zhes// gna' dus grub chen mang dag gis// btang snyoms mdzad mod gzhan du ci// 'di la nyes tshogs yod mi snyam// rgya la mchis na bzod rigs shing*// de brtsams pa yis de'i go 'phang*// 'khor lo'i dbang phyug thob phyir bsngo// dpal dgyes pa rdo rje lha bcu bdun ma'i bdag mdun bum pa slob ma rjes 'dzin dang bcas pa shin tu bsdus par bshad cing*/ bskyed rim gyi tshul slob dpon a bha yā ka ra gup+ta'i rjes su 'brangs te/ rdzus skyes sbyong phyir gtso bor byas pa don gnyis mchog stsol zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ rang nyid kyi nyams len rgyun 'khyer dang*/ gzhan dag gi blo ldan dad pa'i dpal thob cing*/ snod rung ni rdo rje sems dpa' ltar ches dkon mod/ 'on kyang blo dman pa dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig yod srid na/ de rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir/ shākya'i dge slong gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i don gyi rnal 'byor pa rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas/ bod chen po mdo khams lho'i cha gangs ri'i phreng bas mngon par bskor ba'i sa'i thig le ting 'dzin la'i zhol du mgyogs par sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so// //maṅga laṃ shrī dz+wa la dzam+bu dwīpa a laṅkār bha wan+tu//
